## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- Primary filter: active items only
WHERE status = 1

-- Region filter (parameterized)
AND grass_region = '${grass_region}'

-- Lifecycle filter: items created within last 20 days
AND date(create_datetime) >= date_sub(date(from_utc_timestamp(...)), 20)
AND date(create_datetime) <= date(from_utc_timestamp(...))
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### JOIN with traffic.dws_item_metric_1d__reg_live (ROI2 pipeline)

```sql
LEFT JOIN traffic.dws_item_metric_1d__reg_live item_metric
    ON item.item_id = item_metric.item_id
    AND date(item.create_datetime) <= item_metric.grass_date
```

Used across all 10 ROI2 region workflows to join item creation info with daily performance metrics.

### JOIN with mp_paidads.ods_log_paidads_index_hi__reg_s0_live (coverage check)

```sql
INNER JOIN mp_paidads.ods_log_paidads_index_hi__reg_s0_live ads
    ON org.item_id = ads.item_id
WHERE ads.grass_region = 'SG'
```

### JOIN with mp_paidads.ods_shopee_paidads_index_log (coverage check)

```sql
JOIN (
    SELECT item_id
    FROM mp_item.rt_dim_item__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = 'ID'
    GROUP BY item_id
) B ON A.item_id = B.item_id
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- Typical aggregation pattern in ROI2 workflow
SELECT
    item_id,
    create_datetime,
    create_timestamp,
    SUM(IF(date(create_datetime) >= date_sub(grass_date, 10), imp_cnt_1d, 0)) AS imp_cnt_acc,
    SUM(IF(date(create_datetime) >= date_sub(grass_date, 10), click_cnt_1d, 0)) AS click_cnt_acc,
    SUM(IF(date(create_datetime) >= date_sub(grass_date, 20), atc_cnt_1d, 0)) AS atc_cnt_acc
GROUP BY item_id, create_datetime, create_timestamp
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: ROI2 new item performance (typical pattern, all 10 regions)

```sql
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE dws_item_simple_roi2_npb_created_nd__reg_s0_live
PARTITION (tz_type, grass_region, grass_date)
SELECT
    item.item_id,
    item.create_datetime,
    item.create_timestamp,
    SUM(IF(date(item.create_datetime) >= date_sub(item_metric.grass_date, 10), item_metric.imp_cnt_1d, 0)) AS imp_cnt_acc,
    SUM(IF(date(item.create_datetime) >= date_sub(item_metric.grass_date, 10), item_metric.click_cnt_1d, 0)) AS click_cnt_acc,
    SUM(IF(date(item.create_datetime) >= date_sub(item_metric.grass_date, 20), item_metric.atc_cnt_1d, 0)) AS atc_cnt_acc,
    'local' AS tz_type,
    '${grass_region}' AS grass_region,
    cast('${grass_date}' AS date) AS grass_date
FROM (
    SELECT item_id, create_datetime, create_timestamp
    FROM mp_item.rt_dim_item__reg_s0_live
    WHERE status = 1
        AND grass_region = '${grass_region}'
        AND date(create_datetime) >= date_sub(date(from_utc_timestamp(to_utc_timestamp(
            concat('${grass_date}', ' ', lpad('${BIZ_H}', 2, 0), ':00:00'), 'Asia/Singapore'),
            '${timezone}')), 20)
        AND date(create_datetime) <= date(from_utc_timestamp(to_utc_timestamp(
            concat('${grass_date}', ' ', lpad('${BIZ_H}', 2, 0), ':00:00'), 'Asia/Singapore'),
            '${timezone}'))
) item
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT item_id, imp_cnt_1d, click_cnt_1d, atc_cnt_1d, grass_region, grass_date
    FROM traffic.dws_item_metric_1d__reg_live
    WHERE grass_region = '${grass_region}'
        AND grass_date >= date_sub('${grass_date}', 20)
        AND grass_date <= date('${grass_date}')
) item_metric
    ON item.item_id = item_metric.item_id
    AND date(item.create_datetime) <= item_metric.grass_date
GROUP BY item.item_id, item.create_datetime, item.create_timestamp
```

### Snippet 2: Ads index coverage — missing items check

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing_ids
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_paidads_index_hi__reg_s0_live ads
WHERE ads.grass_region = 'SG'
    AND ads.grass_date = DATE('2024-10-25')
    AND ads.item_id NOT IN (
        SELECT item_id FROM mp_item.rt_dim_item__reg_s0_live
    );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS including_ids
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_paidads_index_hi__reg_s0_live ads
WHERE ads.grass_region = 'SG'
    AND ads.grass_date = DATE('2024-10-25')
    AND ads.item_id IN (
        SELECT item_id FROM mp_item.rt_dim_item__reg_s0_live
    );
```

### Snippet 3: Ads index coverage — deduped item overlap

```sql
SELECT count(*)
FROM (
    SELECT item_id
    FROM mp_paidads.ods_shopee_paidads_index_log
    WHERE grass_region = 'ID'
        AND grass_date = DATE('2024-11-09')
        AND operation = 'INDEX'
        AND visible = 1
        AND placement IN (2, 802, 1002, 1202, 5, 805, 1005, 1205, 40, 50)
    GROUP BY item_id
) A
JOIN (
    SELECT item_id
    FROM mp_item.rt_dim_item__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = 'ID'
    GROUP BY item_id
) B ON A.item_id = B.item_id
```

## Write Lineage (生产血缘)

No INSERT/CREATE statements for this table found in the codebase. This is an upstream table owned by the mp_item platform data team, consumed as a read-only data source by ads workflows.

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

No derived metrics extracted — this is a dimension table. Metrics are computed downstream in the ROI2 pipeline using item creation timestamps as window boundaries for accumulated aggregations (imp_cnt_acc, click_cnt_acc, atc_cnt_acc within N days of creation).
